about: EL1's and EL8's goldens (SPEC-ui-and-copy-pass.md § 8): every sample message of test/email-fixture.mjs, its text and HTML parts, rendered by recorded_at's own src/worker/messages.js from `inputs` (test/el-record.mjs, which wrote each section). `before` is the tree before § 8's code and is never re-recorded: E-X must stay byte-identical to it, and every line of its E1 is either still in E1 or one § 8 removes or replaces (EL8). `after` is E1 as § 8 built it, re-recorded only when E1 is MEANT to change, by running the recorder; never by hand.
